summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Virtus Zevenbergen Discovery Growth ETF (ZDIS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of discovery growth companies. The fund uses a research-intensive, bottom-up stock-selection process ZDIS was launched on Aug 17, 2026 and is issued by Virtus Investment Partners.

holdings.infoBox: ZDIS is an equity ETF with a total of 33 individual holdings. The top holdings are Tesla stock at 8.67%, NVIDIA at 7.47%, Credo Technology Group Holding at 7.14%, Axon Enterprise at 6.62%, and Shopify at 6.07%.
